title: Core Awakening
tagline: Rebuild yourself piece by piece in a tactical salvage battle.
pitch: As a fragmented Titan AI, you must navigate a compact arena, tactically dismantling enemies to salvage components that enhance your mech and identity. Each choice affects your survival and strategic approach, creating a thrilling real-time combat experience.
coreLoop: Read enemy attack patterns, dodge or interrupt, strategically target subsystems, defeat the enemy while preserving valuable components, and make decisions on how to use your salvage.

mechanics.name: Tactical Dismantling
mechanics.description: Defeating enemies through targeted attacks generates salvaged components that lead to immediate strategic decisions.

mechanics.name: Subsystem Targeting
mechanics.description: Players can aim at specific parts of the enemy, changing the outcome of the battle based on which subsystem is destroyed or preserved.

mechanics.name: Three-Way Decision
mechanics.description: After defeating an enemy, players must choose to install, secure, or dismantle the salvaged component, each with distinct consequences.

controls.keyboard: WASD for movement, mouse for aiming and targeting
controls.mouse: Left-click to attack, right-click to evade/interrupt

artDirection.backgroundFx: large machinery silhouettes subtly moving in the background

difficulty.start: basic enemy attacks with clear telegraphs
difficulty.progression: introducing more complex attack patterns as players become more adept
difficulty.peak: multiple decision points and intense enemy behavior toward the end of the 60 seconds

winLose.lose: failure to defeat the enemy resulting in a loss of the core integrity

juice.screenShake: upon impact when attacking or defeated enemy
juice.particles: when components are salvaged or destroyed
juice.hitStop: when a successful interrupt is performed
juice.flash: when making a crucial decision after battle

scopeNotes: Do not build procedural dungeons, economy/shop systems, multiple enemy types, bosses, inventory management, upgrades between runs, narrative scenes beyond one line of text, or save systems beyond engine defaults.

scoreEvents: score increases when an enemy is dismantled, when a subsystem is targeted, and when a decision is made post-battle
